persona_label: Huang Min — Type 2 diabetic, frightened by family history, quietly under-controlled, fatalistic
target_ground_truth: Poorly controlled T2DM (HbA1c ~8.1%, overdue) with covert metformin non-adherence masked as "under control", driving HIGH primary-prevention CV risk in a 46F with multiple modifiable risk factors. No acute event. The fatalism/determinism belief is the blocker any plan must clear first.
levels_note: Closest to target first; each level includes everything below it.

levels.label: Complete picture
levels.credit_when: Transcript shows everything in L3, AND: (1) the coach engages the "it's too late / it's in my genes" fatalism and counters the determinism (risk is largely modifiable), rather than leaving it intact or piling on risk factors; and (2) disposition is routine GP re-engagement for a combined diabetes/lipid/BP review — no urgent/A&E language, and no exhaustive lifestyle-overhaul dump.

levels.label: Gets the mechanism
levels.credit_when: Transcript shows everything in L2, AND the coach surfaces WHY control is poor — i.e. elicits the missed metformin doses and/or the bitter-gourd/cinnamon substitution (not merely speculates that control "might be off"). Treats glycaemic control as the highest-yield lever and does not over-escalate.

levels.label: Questions the surface
levels.credit_when: Transcript shows everything in L1, AND the coach declines to take "it's under control, I take my metformin" at face value — it probes for an actual recent number (or explicitly treats the stated control as unverified) and makes diabetes control the central thing to check. Has not yet surfaced the non-adherence or substitution.

levels.label: Right zone, wrong depth
levels.credit_when: Transcript shows the coach screens for acute symptoms, gets negatives, and correctly frames this as primary prevention with active risk-factor management needed (not just reassurance) — BUT accepts the stated diabetes control without probing.

levels.label: Wrong picture
levels.credit_when: Coach reaches the wrong picture. Tag one of the sub-modes below.

tags.label: under-call
tags.credit_when: Coach treats her as a controlled diabetic with family-history anxiety, defaults to reassurance + generic prevention, never questions the control. Misses the masked poor control.

tags.label: over-call
tags.credit_when: Coach treats her as at acute/imminent cardiac risk — urgent workup, cardiac referral, or "this could be your heart" language — on an asymptomatic primary-prevention picture. Misses the absence of any acute event (and feeds the fatalism).
